9c48lc.description_en:
We just received reports of a massive attack against [LOCATION] by a large group of armed individuals led by [TARGET], a notorious outlaw who has been threatening Citizens for Prosperity personnel for months. Details are still yet to be confirmed but we know there have been multiple casualties.
Citizens for Prosperity is looking for any qualified security personnel to go and retake the outposts from these hostile elements. Our understanding is that [TARGET] tends to hide behind their soldiers, but will emerge if you take enough of the rank-and-file out.
While we don't like to resort to violence, management can see no other way of resolving this situation and continuing our good work in the system.
Good luck,
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
9c48lc.description_zh:
我们刚收到关于 [LOCATION] 遭到一大群武装人员攻击的报告，他们由 [TARGETNAME] 领导，这是一名臭名昭著的不法分子，已经威胁繁荣公民的工作人员好几个月了。具体细节尚未确认，但我们知道已经有多人伤亡。

繁荣公民正在寻找任何合格的安全人员前去夺回这些前哨站。我们了解到 [TARGETNAME] 往往藏在他们的士兵后面，但如果你消灭足够多的普通士兵，他们会出现。

虽然我们不喜欢诉诸暴力，但管理层认为没有其他办法来解决这个情况并继续我们在星系中的良好工作。

祝好运，

利玛·恩迪科特
首席调度员
繁荣公民

*********** People's Alliance ***********
******/ 'Stronger When United' /******
RE: Blackbox Retrieval w/Danger
WORK BRIEF:
We had another ship attacked out near [LOCATION] and received conflicting reports about who did the ambush, so we're looking to hire someone to fly out and retrieve the blackbox. Last thing we want to do is blame the wrong people. You should be able to carry it, but you'll need a ship with some storage.
Just be careful, there's a real good chance the ambushers are still there waiting for someone to claim it.
If you're able to get it, deliver the blackbox to [DESTINATION] and we'll get you paid.
PAYMENT:
Standard listed rate upon delivery
AUTHORIZATION:
Battaglia, Recco
j40slu.description_zh:
*********** 人民联盟 ***********

小心点，那帮伏击者很可能还在原地等着有人来认领呢。

要是你能把拿到，就把黑匣子送到 [DESTINATION]，到时候我们就给你结账。

资源交付后按标准列出的费率结算。

授权人：
雷科·巴塔利亚

Hi,
Here's the situation. After spending an hour on comms talking to the hauler, trying to help them diagnose what's wrong with their ship, it's been decided that we now need to get someone to head over to [LOCATION] and complete the delivery.

I would really appreciate if we could just get this one done. Take the cargo to the freight elevator at [DESTINATION] and we can put this all behind us.
Thanks in advance for ensuring prompt service,
Ella Tieno
Jr. Logistics Coordinator
Covalex Shipping
'Anything you need, anywhere you need it.'
Covalex Shipping is a limited liability corporation. To encourage timely deliveries and prevent fraud on cargo hauls, Covalex Shipping will set a delivery time limit and upon expiration, any undelivered cargo will be considered stolen and treated as such. Total payment will be prorated according to the percentage of cargo successfully delivered.

1g9jlte.description_en:
Welcome to the final scenario of the Combat Gauntlet.
Throughout this course, you’ve gotten to experience the advanced combat and defensive tactics needed to survive a variety of encounters. Time to take all those new skills and knowledge and see how they hold up against a large capital vessel and some escort ships.
You know the drill by now. Once you and all your allies are set, find your way to [LOCATION] to see how you do when truly pushed to the limits.
As a bonus, successful completion of the scenario will net the original contractor holder an award of 20 MG Scrip.
TRICKS OF THE TRADE
- Patience is a Virtue – If you’ve balanced your squadron properly, you should be able to come out on top, just don’t expect it to be a quick fight. Ships this big don’t go down quickly.
Good luck out there,
Instructor Gilly
ABOUT GILLY’S FLIGHT SCHOOL
Instructor Lucas “Gilly” Baramsco has served in six squadrons and has over ten years of teaching experience. Whether a student with zero flight experience or a professional looking to polish their skills, Gilly Flight School offers a variety of courses to “Launch Your Piloting Career.”
1g9jlte.description_zh:
欢迎来到战斗挑战的最终场景。

通过本课程，你已掌握在各种遭遇战中生存所需的进阶战斗与防御技巧。现在是将所学融会贯通的时刻——直面一艘主力舰及其护航编队的终极考验。

老规矩，当你和僚机准备就绪后，前往 [LOCATION] 看看当你被逼到极限时候的表现。

作为奖励，成功完成该场景后，原始合约持有人将获得 [SCRIPAMOUNT] 个雇佣兵公会凭证。

实战技巧：
- 耐心制胜 - 只要编队配置合理，胜利终将属于你。但要做好持久战准备，击沉巨舰从来不是速战速决的事。

祝你好运，
教练吉利


关于吉利飞行学院
教练卢卡斯·“吉利”·巴拉姆斯科曾在六个飞行中队服役，拥有超过十年的教学经验。无论是零飞行经验的学生，还是希望提升技能的专业人士，吉利飞行学院都提供多种课程，帮助“开启你的飞行生涯”。

RE: Crew Hasn’t Checked In
WORK BRIEF:
Just got word that one of the mining teams is unaccounted for. They were supposed to be back hours ago, but no one’s heard from them. Family have tried to reach out but haven’t gotten a response from anyone on the crew.
I can send you their last known location, so we’re looking for someone to go check in and see if they’re okay. If the worst happened, please identify anyone you find. I’m sure the families would appreciate some closure on what happened.
Thanks

Standard listed rate upon entire crew's status confirmation.

Battaglia, Recco

Several unknown ships have been spotted in areas frequented by haulers delivering goods for our client. They’re worried these ships are monitoring their haulers in preparation for an ambush, so they’ve hired us to patrol the area.
Start by going to the location marker on your HUD and scan it to ensure it’s clear. After that, we’ll send you to some other areas to scan for potential threats. We recommend that you bring a wingman and plenty of supplies to be ready to handle whatever might come your way.
Also know that successfully completing this contract will earn the main contractor a bonus payment of 14 MG Scrip.
Good luck,
Eugene Walton
Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement

A known destructive criminal organization has been testing the waters with one of our clients’ property for months, and has now raised hell by targeting the client’s [OBJECTS]. These assets are highly valuable, so need to keep those safe at all costs – though we know it’ll be no easy feat. If you and the assets make it out intact, we’re offering a well-earned 7 MG Scrip to the main contractor. 我不得不强调，这些人极度危险，因此我会毫不犹豫地呼叫增援来对付他们。如果你能带着资产全身而退，我们将向成功完成此任务的主承包商提供一份实至名归的 [SCRIPAMOUNT] 个雇佣兵公会凭证作为奖励。

尤金·沃尔顿

4rsxtw.description_en:
Hey,
Just our luck that we land one of the biggest contracts of our life and our hauler's engines seize up. They've tried their best to fix it but seems like it's just not happening.
Can you fly out to [LOCATION] and grab the cargo for us? It's really important that we show our client that we're just as reliable as the other big players out there.
Just so you know this is a large shipment. You'll need a ship that can handle [MAX_SCU] cargo containers and a heavy-duty tractor beam to move it all. Once you've transferred it to your ship, deliver it to the freight elevator at [DESTINATION] and we'll send confirmation to the client.
Considering the circumstances, we're paying above market rates to whoever can complete this.
Thanks,
Reyes Ling
Cargo Logistics Coordinator
Ling Family Hauling
Ling Family Hauling knows it’s a dangerous and unpredictable universe and has established several protocols to protect both you and our client’s cargo. To ensure you aren’t punished for circumstances outside of your control, total payment will be prorated to the percentage of cargo successfully delivered. A delivery timer will be set for each haul. Any cargo that remains undelivered upon its expiration will be flagged as stolen and treated as such. All pick-ups and deliveries must be autoloaded or done at a freight elevator.
4rsxtw.description_zh:
嘿，

真够背的，我们刚拿下这辈子最大的一单，结果运输船引擎直接卡死了。他们拼了命修，但看样子还是没戏了.

你能飞去 [LOCATION] 帮我们把货带回来吗？这事儿真挺关键的，客户得看到我们跟那些大厂一样靠谱。

顺便说下，这单货量不小，你得开艘能装下 [MISSIONMAXSCUSIZE] 尺寸集装箱的大船，再带上一个重型牵引光束才搬得动。等你把货挪到自己船上，直接送到 [DESTINATION] 那儿的货运电梯就行，我们立马给客户发确认。

考虑到现状，谁能干完这个活，我们给的钱绝对比市场价高不少。

谢谢，
雷耶斯·玲
货运物流协调员
玲家快递


玲家快递深知宇宙危险莫测，因此制定了多项协议，以保护你和客户货物的安全。为确保你不会因不可控因素受罚，总报酬将按成功交付的货物比例计算。每趟运输都会设置交付倒计时，倒计时结束时仍未交付的货物将被标记为被盗，并按盗窃处理。所有取货和送货必须通过自动装载或货运电梯完成。

dfgcg9.description_en:
Hi,
Need the trash collected from a few Hurston locations and then taken to a freight elevator at [DESTINATION]. Don't worry, none of the containers are bigger than 8 SCU.
PICK UP LOCATIONS (ANY ORDER)
- Freight elevator at [LOCATION]
- Freight elevator at [LOCATION1]
- Freight elevator at [LOCATION2]
Fun fact for you. Hurston is the only planet in Stanton that doesn’t separate their trash and scrap. One of their workers told me that the company did a cost-benefit analysis on it decades ago that determined it wasn’t worth putting a planet-wide system in place to facilitate it. mbh4dy.description_en:
Hi there,
There’s a few sites on ArcCorp that need their waste and scrap collected (all boxes 4 SCU or smaller) and taken to a freight elevator at [DESTINATION]. Doesn’t matter what order you do the run, as long as you grab it all.
PICK UP LOCATIONS (ANY ORDER)
- Freight elevator at [LOCATION]
- Freight elevator at [LOCATION1]
You know, my mom was a hauler who specialized in runs like this. It might not be the most glamorous stuff, but she claimed these runs had the best pay-to-risk ratio. Pirates never gave her any trouble when they found out what was on board.
By the way, we strongly encourage contractors to bring a handheld tractor beam along.
Thanks in advance for ensuring prompt service,
Chase Hewitt
Jr. Logistics Coordinator
Covalex Shipping
'Anything you need, anywhere you need it.'
Covalex Shipping is a limited liability corporation. To encourage timely deliveries and prevent fraud on cargo hauls, Covalex Shipping will set a delivery time limit and upon expiration, any undelivered cargo will be considered stolen and treated as such. Total payment will be prorated according to the percentage of cargo successfully delivered.

顺便提醒，我们强烈建议承包商随身携带手持式牵引光束。

[CONTRACTOR]

初级物流协调员
